# pve-rclone-backup

Offsite replication of Proxmox VE backups through rclone.

pve-rclone-backup manages pve-rclone-backupd: transport remotes, offsite storages, the upload queue,
offsite backups and recovery kits.

Run the commands as root on a Proxmox VE node.

```
pve-rclone-backup <command> [flags]
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`backup`](backup.md) | List and inspect offsite backups |
| [`completion`](completion.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell |
| [`config`](config.md) | Configuration schemas |
| [`doctor`](doctor.md) | Check the installation and report problems |
| [`hook`](hook.md) | Optional vzdump hook that reports finished archives to the daemon |
| [`queue`](queue.md) | Show and control the upload queue |
| [`recover`](recover.md) | Disaster recovery: import a recovery kit and add its storages read-only |
| [`recovery-kit`](recovery-kit.md) | Export, confirm, verify and import recovery kits |
| [`remote`](remote.md) | Manage transport remotes (cloud accounts) |
| [`restore`](restore.md) | Restore a guest from an offsite backup |
| [`retention`](retention.md) | Preview and apply offsite retention (the storage's prune-backups) |
| [`status`](status.md) | Show daemon health, storages and the upload queue |
| [`storage`](storage.md) | Manage offsite (rclone-backup) storages |
| [`tui`](tui.md) | Interactive terminal interface |
| [`verify`](verify.md) | Verification history |
| [`version`](version.md) | Show CLI and daemon versions |

## Global options

Every command accepts these options.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output string` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |
| `--socket string` | daemon API socket (default `/run/pve-rclone-backup/api.sock`) |
| `-v, --version` | version for pve-rclone-backup |
| `-y, --yes` | do not ask for confirmation |

## Exit status

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success. |
| 1 | The command failed. |
| 2 | Usage error: an unknown command or flag, or invalid arguments. |
| 3 | The daemon cannot be reached. |
| 4 | The command line tool and the daemon speak incompatible API versions. |
| 5 | The command completed and found problems (`doctor`, `recover`, `recovery-kit verify`). |
